title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.convert.html_to_tree tool
_comment: WP-H12 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness §8; 13-tool-catalog §1.9). convert.html_to_tree is READ-ONLY (readOnlyHint, no persistence — TS Playwright render-then-extract), so this payload runs UNCONDITIONALLY: no disposable draft needed. MINIMAL valid input per the §1.9 inputSchema: only `html` is required (css/generation/options optional; generation defaults to v4). The suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a well-formed result matching the tool outputSchema (elements/proposed_classes/proposed_variables/report). requires.experiments gates v4 atomic output so the suite is green on the dev install (and any v4-disabled site SKIPS rather than fails).
